Declan, saw Rewst launch RoboRewsty and publish your 2026 State of MSP Automation report.

A new AI builder plus a fresh report usually surfaces more in-market MSP accounts than a global team can cover while the attention is high, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Rewst off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

Declan, quick follow-up for Rewst.

With 1,500-plus MSPs already on board, the global number usually climbs faster than the team can prospect new logos, and most leaders cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it this quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Rewst needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Declan, last bit of proof for Rewst.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Rewst's reply rate likely compares to other automation startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
